hero.title: Direct from Our Farms to You.
hero.desc: Meki Batu Union operates five official retail stores across Addis Ababa, providing urban households with fresh, daily harvested produce directly from member farms.
hero.imageAlt: Pristine fresh produce display in a modern retail setting

locations.title: Find an Outlet
locations.desc: Browse store locations below to check opening hours, view produce specialties, and get instant Google Maps navigation.

network.title: Addis Ababa Distribution Hub
network.desc: Daily refrigerated supply runs maintain field-fresh quality across all our retail branches.

freshProduce.title: Direct From Member Cooperatives to Addis Ababa
freshProduce.desc: By cutting out intermediary brokers, Meki Batu Union ensures that farmers receive fair value while urban consumers get crisp, freshly harvested produce every single morning.
freshProduce.perk1Desc: Harvested in the Rift Valley, pre-cooled at our Meki hub, and delivered before dawn to Addis stores.
freshProduce.perk2Desc: Direct cooperative distribution eliminates middleman markups, keeping prices affordable.
freshProduce.perk3Desc: Zero pesticide residues and sanitary handling verified from farm gate to checkout counter.
freshProduce.imageAlt: Fresh produce delivery arrives at an Addis Ababa retail store

cta.title: Wholesale & Commercial Institutional Supply
cta.desc: Supplying hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, and institutional kitchens across Addis Ababa with bulk farm-fresh produce.
